bibliographic_scope.title: Room Temperature Synthesis of Cubic Nanocrystalline CdSe in Aqueous Solution
bibliographic_scope.authors: Weixin Zhang; Cheng Wang; Lei Zhang; Xiaoming Zhang; Xianming Liu; Kaibin Tang; Yitai Qian

source_interpretation.text: The authors propose selenide, selenite and polyselenide species in the deep-red stock and report stability only with OH− concentration greater than 10 M. The value describes the source explanation, not a separately measured batch concentration.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Equations 1–2 and selenium-source discussion

source_interpretation.text: The authors attribute reduced hydroxide by-product to cadmium complexation and discuss release of Cd2+ as precipitation proceeds. The source reports no CdSeO3 detected by XRD or XPS. No separate quantified bare-cadmium control recipe or measured by-product fraction is supplied.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Equations 3–5 and mechanism discussion

source_interpretation.text: The source says dilute 0.1 M HCl can remove small Cd(OH)2 amounts and water can remove excess cadmium complex; excess elemental Se can precipitate during washing and be difficult to remove. These are conditional source explanations, not extra measured batches.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Workup and stoichiometry discussion

source_interpretation.text: About 80 °C is the self-heating selenium-stock temperature. The source separately describes CdSe precipitation at room temperature; no stock-cooling interval is given.

reagent_source.statement: The source states that all reagents were of 99.9% purity from Shanghai Chemistry Co. and were used without further purification; manipulations and reactions were conducted in air. The global statement does not resolve EDTA salt identity, individual solution assays or the unnamed optical alcohol.

characterization.xrd: Rigaku D/max-rA rotation-anode diffractometer, Ni-filtered Cu Kα radiation. Source-refined a = 0.61 nm compared with JCPDS 19-191; no reference numeric cell copied.
characterization.microscopy: Hitachi H-800 TEM and selected-area electron diffraction; 111, 220, 311 rings assigned to cubic blende CdSe. Accelerating voltage unreported.
characterization.xps: ESCALab MKII with Al Kα source; C 1s carbon-contamination line 284.8 eV used for correction. No obvious cadmium oxide/hydroxide or selenium oxide peaks; no quantitative detection limit.
characterization.optical: Shimadzu UV–vis absorption, room temperature, 1 cm quartz cuvettes; CdSe dispersed in unspecified alcohol.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–3, Experimental characterization, Results and Figures 1–4

comparison_context.text: Prior solid-state, organometallic, gas, ammonia and nonaqueous routes are cited in the introduction. The source cites amorphous aqueous CdE requiring 200–500 °C crystallization and ethylenediamine nanorods at 120–180 °C; these are not preparations performed here.
The source compares the product absorption with a 716 nm bulk band-gap wavelength. This is a reference comparison, not a measured second source specimen.

limitations: Complete supplied four-page main, Figures 1–4, equations 1–5 and all 17 references. SI and cited full sources unreviewed.
One actual aqueous precipitation preparation is reported. Literature comparisons and proposed mechanistic alternatives are not additional independently prepared source batches.

Room temperature is not numerically specified. The selenium stock self-heats to about 80 °C; cooling or equilibration before the reported room-temperature precipitation is not described. No external heating step is inferred.
Precipitation is described as rapid and occurring at once; numerical mixing/aging duration, stirring rate, vessel type/capacity and recovered yield are unreported.
Acid/water wash volumes and repetition count, filtration hardware and vacuum pressure are unreported.
EDTA is named without salt/counterion or starting protonation state. The alcohol for optical-sample dispersion is unnamed; neither ethanol nor methanol is inferred.
The statement that all reagents were 99.9% purity does not specify individual water/solution assays. Distilled water is explicitly named.

Cubic blende assignment, refined lattice parameter, Scherrer size and TEM size range remain technique-specific. No measured atomic coordinates, refined occupancies, complete particle-coordinate model or quantitative detection limits are supplied.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
